description: This file defines the PreparedKamonTimer class, which implements a timer using the Kamon monitoring library. It provides methods for creating, tagging, recording, and resetting timers, as well as retrieving timing metrics.

classes.name: PreparedKamonTimer
classes.description: Implements a Kamon-based timer with tagging, recording, and snapshot capabilities.

methods.name: newTimer
methods.description: Creates a new PreparedKamonTimer instance with the specified name.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of all tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds or updates a single tag.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer, returning a StartedTimer instance.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a duration in the timer after converting to nanoseconds.

methods.name: getNumberOfRecords
methods.description: Returns the number of recorded measurements.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the timer, optionally resetting it.

methods.name: getKamonInternalTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the Kamon Timer with current tags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the timer.
